labelling: Author-labelled from the intended meaning of the fixed knowledge-base articles; not independently expert validated.
notes: Each query is a realistic paraphrase rather than a copy of an article title. Category is the category supplied to the implemented retriever and relevant_kb_ids lists every article accepted as relevant before running the evaluation.

queries.query: I reset my corporate password this morning. Email accepts the new password, but the VPN says authentication failed and no MFA prompt appears.
queries.label_reason: The failure started after a password reset, is limited to VPN authentication, and includes the missing MFA prompt described by KB-001.

queries.query: Since our mailbox moved to Microsoft 365, desktop Outlook stays on Updating Inbox even though all new messages are visible in webmail.
queries.label_reason: The desktop-versus-webmail difference after a cloud mailbox migration is the defining pattern of KB-002.

queries.query: My developer laptop becomes extremely slow and nearly runs out of memory whenever Docker Desktop, VS Code and several browser tabs are open together.
queries.label_reason: The slowdown is specifically caused by the simultaneous developer workload covered by KB-003.

queries.query: A client-facing employee's laptop shows a blue screen several times every day and the problem has returned after earlier support tickets.
queries.label_reason: Recurring daily blue screens on a critical user's laptop match KB-004.

queries.query: The keyboard and mouse randomly disconnect when connected through the USB-C dock, but both devices work normally when plugged straight into the laptop.
queries.label_reason: The peripherals fail only through the docking station, which distinguishes KB-005.

queries.query: After installing the latest major Windows feature update, the laptop now takes around eight minutes to reach the sign-in screen.
queries.label_reason: The long boot began immediately after a Windows feature update, the causal pattern in KB-006.

queries.query: Windows warns that the C drive has almost no free space, File Explorer shows it in red, and I cannot save another document.
queries.label_reason: The explicit low-space warning and inability to save identify KB-007.

queries.query: Chrome consumes most of the laptop's RAM when many tabs are open; the fans become loud and every other application stops responding.
queries.label_reason: Browser memory consumption with many tabs and whole-machine slowdown matches KB-008.

queries.query: Corporate Wi-Fi disconnects for a few seconds throughout the day, web pages time out, and the VPN drops each time before reconnecting.
queries.label_reason: Repeated Wi-Fi and VPN disconnect/reconnect behaviour is the issue pattern in KB-009.

queries.query: Google and other public websites load, but intranet, Jira and Confluence all report server not found when I use their internal names.
queries.label_reason: Public connectivity works while internal names fail, indicating the internal DNS pattern covered by KB-010.

queries.query: Documents remain in the Windows print queue, the office printer appears offline, and cancelling the stuck jobs does nothing.
queries.label_reason: A stuck print queue with an offline printer and undeletable jobs matches KB-011.

queries.query: There was no recent update, but signing in takes several minutes and many programs launch automatically before the desktop becomes usable.
queries.label_reason: General slow login associated with startup applications, without an update trigger, distinguishes KB-012 from KB-006.

queries.query: My domain account is unlocked by support, then locks again within ten minutes even when I carefully enter the correct password.
queries.label_reason: Repeated lockout shortly after an unlock is the defining pattern of KB-013.

queries.query: I replaced my phone and no longer have the old authenticator app, so I cannot approve the MFA request needed to sign in.
queries.label_reason: Loss of the enrolled MFA device after a phone replacement matches KB-014.

queries.query: During Teams calls I cannot hear anyone and Teams does not list my headset microphone, although the headset works in other applications.
queries.label_reason: Audio works elsewhere but is unavailable specifically in Teams, the pattern in KB-015.

queries.query: Outlook says my mailbox quota is exceeded and every new message remains in the outbox, although incoming mail still arrives.
queries.label_reason: A full mailbox preventing sends while receipt continues matches KB-016.

queries.query: The Start menu, taskbar and File Explorer have frozen, but other running programs still respond and the computer itself has not crashed.
queries.label_reason: The Windows shell is frozen while the wider machine remains responsive, which identifies KB-017.

queries.query: The same Windows update downloads each day, fails with an error during installation, rolls back and then asks to install again.
queries.label_reason: A repeating install-fail-rollback cycle is the update failure pattern in KB-018.

queries.query: My second monitor remains blank after docking and Windows display settings cannot detect it, even after reconnecting the display cable.
queries.label_reason: An external display that is not detected through the dock or cable matches KB-019.

queries.query: The laptop battery falls from full to empty in less than two hours and sometimes stops charging even though the power adapter is connected.
queries.label_reason: Abnormal drain combined with intermittent failure to charge is covered by KB-020.

queries.query: The finance shared drive now has a red cross and opening its mapped drive letter gives access denied, while local folders work normally.
queries.label_reason: A mapped departmental share showing a red cross and access failure matches KB-021.

queries.query: A business application worked yesterday, updated overnight, and now closes immediately every time it is launched.
queries.label_reason: Immediate startup crashes beginning after an application update match KB-022.

queries.query: Copying a large file to the department network share starts slowly, drops to almost zero speed and eventually times out.
queries.label_reason: The problem is transfer performance to a network share rather than loss of access, which identifies KB-023.

queries.query: I received an unexpected invoice email whose sender address looks unusual and whose link asks me to enter my company password.
queries.label_reason: An unexpected credential-harvesting invoice message is the phishing case covered by KB-024.

queries.query: My browser homepage changed without permission, searches redirect to unfamiliar sites, and a toolbar extension appeared that I never installed.
queries.label_reason: Unauthorized homepage, redirects, and extension changes match the browser-hijack pattern in KB-025.

queries.query: A Bluetooth mouse no longer appears in the list of nearby devices and will not pair after I removed its previous connection.
queries.label_reason: A discoverability and pairing failure for a Bluetooth peripheral matches KB-026.

queries.query: The VPN client reports Connected from home, but every internal business application times out; those applications work normally in the office.
queries.label_reason: The VPN tunnel connects successfully but internal routes fail, distinguishing KB-027 from authentication failure in KB-001.

queries.query: While working from home I was told my password has expired, but the sign-in screen will not let me change it unless I connect to the company network.
queries.label_reason: An expired password that cannot be changed while off-network is the remote-access pattern in KB-028.

queries.query: Windows displayed a SMART disk-health warning and advised me to back up my files; the laptop also makes clicking sounds and sometimes freezes.
queries.label_reason: SMART warnings, backup advice, clicking, and freezes indicate the disk-health issue in KB-029.

queries.query: At about the same time every morning the antivirus process uses nearly all CPU, the fan becomes loud and the laptop is unusable until its scan ends.
queries.label_reason: A scheduled antivirus scan causing a repeated high-CPU slowdown matches KB-030.
